name: A Cosmos sheet per component instead of one shared sheet
body: The bridge merges every ui/*.cosmos except global.cosmos into one component sheet, so rules, :root variables and duplicate classes cross files (D-043; review on lantern PR #9). Cosmos treats the component layer as the component's own file. Pick the sheet per mounted component by file name (main-menu.chaos with main-menu.cosmos) and resolve each subtree against its own sheet.

comments.text: Filed 2026-10-30 from Dean's review of lantern PR #9; the merge is documented in docs/game-api.md for now.
